posts.title: So sick and Tried of this
posts.description: I am so sick and tired of being distracted by the things that don't matter. Why is it that I get the motivation to code and ENTIRE website but I can't even get motivated to work on Divine Acid or artwork for it? I'm sick and tired of putting Chance aside for something else. I'm tired of not loving him enough. I'm tired of valuing my him, my comic, and artwork by the things that don't even matter.
